[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A V0 knowledge item has the correct scope and layer, but `source_path` points outside `DEFAULT_V0_ROOT`. What should `validate_v0_item` return?
Reject with `McpError::GuardrailViolation(format!("{} source_path outside V0 root: {}", item.id, item.source_path))`.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A knowledge item has both an invalid `source_scope` and `legacy_allowed = true`. Which guardrail violation fires first in `validate_v0_item`?
Reject first on the invalid `source_scope` guard. Scope validation runs before the legacy-allowed check.

[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=guardrails]
[SEVERITY=major]
Why is `No code facts inferred from V0 direction docs.` an important default guardrail for a retrieval model?
Because direction docs describe intended future or product shape, not verified implementation state. Without that guardrail, the model may hallucinate present code facts from aspirational material.
